headline: 1441 · Rio d'Ouro Nocturnal Raid

items.title: West African Pivot
items.detail: Chronological tracking of Portuguese coastal expeditions under Prince Henry.

items.title: 1441 · Seal-Oil Commission
items.detail: Antão Gonçalves sails to Rio d'Ouro ordered to procure sea-wolf skins and oil.

items.title: 1441 · Nocturnal Kidnapping
items.detail: Gonçalves exceeds orders ashore at night, seizing two Sanhaja Berber captives.

items.title: 12-Year Ideological Lag
items.detail: Twelve full years separate the 1441 raid from Zurara's 1453 racial chronicle.

sources: Zurara (1453); The Original Power, Ch. 2, §2.2 & Ch. 3
